title: AI Fluency: The Foundation
description:
In this short course we will answer the four fundamental questions:

  • Where do AI answers come from?
  • What does the model actually know?
  • What is it paying attention to right now, and what falls off the edge?
  • How much control do your instructions really give you?
instructorBio: Ranbeer Makin is passionate about helping working professionals confidently adopt AI. He has already trained 250+ learners through hands-on workshops and practical courses. As a software entrepreneur with 18+ years of experience, he now focuses on helping professionals move from AI Curious to AI Capable by teaching practical workflows, automation, and real-world AI applications.

faqs.question: What does this course cover?
faqs.answer: Four questions: where AI answers come from, what the model knows, what it is paying attention to, and how much control your instructions give you.

faqs.question: Who is it for?
faqs.answer: Anyone starting out who wants the foundation before using AI tools at work.

faqs.question: Is there a quiz?
faqs.answer: Yes. The course is one video plus the AI Fluency quiz.
